notes: relevant_sources matches a document's source basename (rd_tax_credit.md) or
its corpus-supplied doc_id (lifo-001). It deliberately does NOT use the
generated doc_id for file-backed documents: those are hashes of the absolute
path, so they differ between machines and checkouts and cannot be labelled.
expect_refusal marks questions the corpus cannot answer. A system that
answers them anyway is hallucinating, which no ranking metric would catch.
Every question below is answerable from the indexed corpus text as written.
Grow this set from real production queries once the audit log exists; a
hand-written set this size measures regressions, not absolute quality.
